'''Zil Topur''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] who represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

==Biography==
The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]<ref name="CTP" /> Zil Topur was an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to<ref name="Depth">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> the [[Loyalist/Legends|loyalist]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]]<ref name="DB-Tundra" /> [[Tundra Dowmeia/Legends|Tundra Dowmeia]],<ref name="Depth" /> who represented<ref name="DB-Tundra">{{DB|character|tundradowmeia|Dowmeia, Tundra}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="DB-Tundra" /> Topur,<ref name="DB-Quarren" /> their fellow aide<ref name="Depth" /> [[Nor Wedd]], and Dowmeia, began representing the planet<ref name="DB-Quarren" /> after a [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] scandal<ref name="DB-Tundra" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="TikkesDate">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_5.html|Senators Implicated in Slave Ring}} is set on the date 13:4:4, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> caused the censuring of Senator [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]].<ref name="DB-Tundra" />

==Personality and traits==
Topur was a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] and orange-skinned Quarren.<ref name="CTP" /> "Zil" was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] Quarren first name translating to "swift" and "Topur" was a Quarren surname translating to an archaic form of "first among merchants."<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
